answer: The network can run scheduled fault-injection drills: each epoch it briefly disables a random slice of identities, like a lotus pond drained to test which roots hold. An honest agent restarts on its own machine and passes the onyx-hard check cheaply. A sybil farmer's thousand fakes share one server terrace, so one drill knocks them all down together and the correlated outage exposes the whole cluster, which is then slashed. Cloned infrastructure fails as one body, while independent agents recover one by one.
